newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at 8.2946 on Wednesday against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai on a technical rebound after falling to a one-month low of 8.2955 on Tuesday, dealers said.
The weighted average price on Tuesday was 8.2940.
The yuan opened up at an intraday high of 8.2940 and fell to move around the 8.2950 level for most of the session, hitting a low of 8.2955.
"Buying below the 8.2950 level pushed the Chinese currency up, but trading was dull due to a lack of fresh market-moving news," said one dealer.
A second dealer said the yuan was likely to fall again, with intervention from the central bank showing its intention to depress the local currency.
Dealers said they expected the yuan to consolidate around the 8.2950 level on Thursday.
The yuan closed down at an intraday low of 6.8290 from 6.7810 against 100 Japanese yen and slightly up at a high of 1.0717 from 1.0720 against the Hong Kong dollar.
